info.description: Macro Terminal macro intelligence and fundamental research terminal API.
info.title: Macro Terminal API

get.description: Resolves the session cookie to the local account, creating the user projection on first use. The email comes from the identity provider.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

patch.description: Stores a display username on the signed-in account. The username is optional and is not used to sign in.

schema.description: The username to store, 1 to 64 characters.

requestBody.description: The username to store, 1 to 64 characters.

200.description: The updated account and its session.

400.description: The username is missing or too long.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns stored events newest first. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: The events and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: The limit or cursor is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Stores an event under an existing source and indicator, optionally linked to entities. Values are optional; the scheduled time is required. The same source, indicator, and scheduled time may appear only once.

400.description: A field is missing or a reference is unknown.

404.description: The source, indicator, or an entity code does not exist.

409.description: An event with that source, indicator, and scheduled time already exists.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns reference entities newest first. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: The entities and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: The limit or cursor is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Stores a reference entity. The code must not already exist.

400.description: A field is missing or the body is not valid JSON.

409.description: An entity with that code already exists.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns tradable pairs newest first. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: The pairs and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: The limit or cursor is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Stores a pair of existing entities under an explicit product symbol. Both codes must exist and differ.

400.description: A field is missing or a code is unknown.

409.description: An entity pair with that symbol already exists.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns indicators newest first. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: The indicators and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: The limit or cursor is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Stores an indicator under an existing entity. The name must be unique within that entity.

400.description: A field is missing or the entity code is unknown.

409.description: That entity already has an indicator with this name.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns durable work that exhausted its retries, newest first, optionally filtered by job type. These rows are the dead-letter queue: replay a job to return it to normal processing. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Filter by job type, for example article_enrichment or email_delivery.
parameters.name: type

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: The failed jobs and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: A limit or cursor is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Returns a dead-lettered job to pending state with its attempt counter reset, so workers pick it up again under normal retry rules. Replaying an already pending job is a no-op; jobs in any other state are refused.

parameters.description: Job id (UUID).
parameters.name: id

400.description: The id is not a valid UUID.

409.description: The job is not in a replayable state.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns classification phrases newest first. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: The terms and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: The limit or cursor is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Stores a classification phrase linked to an entity, an indicator, or both. An indicator link carries the indicator's entity automatically.

400.description: A field is missing, no link was given, or a reference is unknown.

409.description: A term with that name and type already exists.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns configuration payloads newest first. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: The configurations and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: The limit or cursor is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Stores a configuration payload for an existing source. The payload must be a JSON object with a url the server is allowed to fetch, may not carry secret values, and the url may not repeat within one source and type.

400.description: The payload is invalid or its url points at a refused address.

409.description: That source already has a configuration for this url.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

patch.description: Replaces the stored payload of an existing configuration. Its source and type stay fixed, the new payload must pass the same validation as a create, and its url must be one the server may fetch.

parameters.description: Source configuration id (UUID).
parameters.name: id

400.description: The id is not a UUID, or the payload is invalid or refused.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns logical sources newest first. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: The sources and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: The limit or cursor is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Stores a logical source. The name must not already exist.

400.description: A field is missing or the body is not valid JSON.

409.description: A source with that name already exists.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns accounts newest first with their role and status, optionally filtered by role or status. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Filter by role: admin or user.
parameters.name: role

parameters.description: Filter by status: active or suspended.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: The accounts and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: A filter, limit, or cursor is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Grants the account full administrative access. Promoting an account that is already an administrator changes nothing. Administrators cannot be demoted.

parameters.description: User id (UUID).
parameters.name: id

400.description: The id is not a valid UUID.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Returns the account to active status so its sessions work again. Reactivating an already active account changes nothing.

parameters.description: User id (UUID).
parameters.name: id

400.description: The id is not a valid UUID.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Marks the account suspended. Every request the account makes is refused with a suspension error from then on. Suspending an already suspended account changes nothing, and an administrator cannot suspend their own account.

parameters.description: User id (UUID).
parameters.name: id

400.description: The id is not a valid UUID.

409.description: The administrator tried to suspend their own account.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns the newest articles mapped to the account's followed asset pairs, newest first, falling back to the whole terminal when nothing is followed. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: The articles and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: The limit or cursor is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns a single article by id.

parameters.description: Article id (UUID).
parameters.name: id

400.description: The request was malformed.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Generates a one-shot contextual explanation of the article from its enrichment, graph entities, affected asset pairs, story cluster, related coverage, and knowledge terms. The generated answer is cached briefly and regenerated after it expires.

parameters.description: Article id (UUID).
parameters.name: id

400.description: The request was malformed.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns story cluster mates first (most recent first), then semantically similar indexed articles, deduplicated and excluding the article itself. When semantic search is not configured only cluster mates are returned.

parameters.description: Article id (UUID).
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

200.description: The related articles, cluster mates first.

400.description: The request was malformed.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry after the indicated delay.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.summary: Get articles related to one article.

get.description: Returns the asset pairs the signed-in account follows, newest follows first. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

200.description: The followed pairs and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: The limit or cursor is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Adds the pair to the signed-in account's watch list. Following the same pair twice keeps a single entry.

400.description: The request body is missing the pair id.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

delete.description: Removes the pair from the signed-in account's watch list. Removing a pair that is not followed succeeds.

parameters.description: The pair id (UUID).
parameters.name: entityPairId

400.description: The pair id is not a UUID.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns scheduled events from now forward, soonest first. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: The events and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: The limit or cursor is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.description: Generates a one-shot contextual explanation of the calendar event from its indicator, values, linked entities, affected asset pairs, and recent related coverage. The generated answer is cached briefly and regenerated after it expires.

parameters.description: Calendar event id (UUID).
parameters.name: id

400.description: The request was malformed.

404.description: The calendar event does not exist.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

post.summary: Explain one calendar event with AI.

get.description: Returns candles for one entity pair and timeframe, newest first. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Entity pair id.
parameters.name: entityPairId

parameters.description: 1min or 1day.
parameters.name: timeframe

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: The candles and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: A parameter is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Returns every tradable pair newest first. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

200.description: The pairs and the cursor for the next page, if any.

400.description: The limit or cursor is invalid.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Embeds the query text, retrieves the closest indexed article ids from the vector index, and hydrates them from PostgreSQL in relevance order. Pass the returned nextCursor to fetch the next page.

parameters.description: Search text, 1 to 500 characters.
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Page size between 1 and 100. Defaults to 25.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Cursor returned by the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

400.description: The request was malformed.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry after the indicated delay.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.description: Answers the process liveness probe; it succeeds as long as the API process can serve HTTP.

400.description: The request was malformed.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry after the indicated delay.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

get.summary: Report whether the API process is alive.

get.description: Answers the readiness probe; it succeeds only when PostgreSQL answers a ping within the readiness timeout, so traffic is held back while the database is unreachable.

400.description: The request was malformed.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry after the indicated delay.

500.description: The request could not be completed.

503.description: PostgreSQL did not answer the ping; the instance is not ready for traffic.
